result:
My round 74 verdict is **FAIL**, with `browserVerified=true`. In the real browser, every marker-move and marker-menu check passed at both 1440x900 and 1280x720. The FAIL comes from a unit test that is still red in the tree. It will fail the root gate, so publishing is blocked until B changes or removes one test line.

**Bugs for B:**
- **C-R74-01 (medium, blocks publishing):** in `markers-ui.test.tsx`, test MU8 at line 526 still expects plain arrow keys on a focused marker to create no undo entry. Under this round's B5 rule they now move the marker by 0.1 s (Snap off), so the undo label is `Move Marker`. I re-ran `markers-ui` plus `markers-move-ui`: 1 failed, 36 passed. A had no permission to edit that line. B needs to allow the one-line change (A suggests `toBe('Move Marker')`) or drop the assertion. A's other MU8e note (two presses never released) fits in the same permission.
- **C-R74-02 (low):** the marker menu stays open at its old screen position when the timeline is scrolled. After a 300 px wheel scroll, the menu points at empty timeline 300 px away from its marker. The lane grid menu closes on scroll. A had already listed this as a known gap.

**Passed at both sizes:**
- **Dragging:**
  - With Snap on it lands on the grid (5 → 7) as one `Move Marker` entry, and Undo/Redo work.
  - Snap off gives a free time (6.370), and Alt flips Snap both ways.
  - A drag doesn't move the playhead; a plain click still jumps and a double-click still plays.
  - Dragging across another marker keeps focus on the dragged one.
- **No duplicates:** a drag onto another marker stops one grid step short, and an arrow press onto it is refused with a message naming that marker.
- **Arrows:** they move by one grid step with Snap on and 0.1 s with it off. A selected clip doesn't move, Ctrl+→ still jumps to the next marker, and ← at 0 shows the message.
- **During playback:** dragging or moving a marker creates no extra audio sources, and the position keeps advancing.
- **Menu:**
  - Right-click opens three items in the agreed order, at the pointer. Near the right edge it stays 4 px inside the window.
  - Only one menu is ever open (lane grid menu vs marker menu, both directions).
  - Arrow keys, Home/End, Escape and Tab work. A click outside only closes it.
  - Shift+F10 and the ContextMenu key open it under the marker.
  - Rename, Play from here (stopped and playing) and Delete all work.
- **Earlier features:** the round-73 checks, rename with F2, Cut Time, the main keyboard shortcuts and the no-hydration-warning check all still pass.
- **Premium access:** an anonymous user sees the demo badge, is asked to sign in on `/studio/middle-east`, and gets 401 from the token API. No forbidden requests or Authorization headers were sent.

**Blocked:** the fake-token 403 check needs the backend, which isn't available in the cloud (it returned 500).

**Not run or unverified:**
- The menu over the floating video window.
- The bottom-edge clamp, which can't be reached at either window size.
- What a real keyboard's context-menu key sends. Simulated key presses fire no context-menu event, so only the key-handler path was tested.
- Safari and macOS behaviour, since only Chromium is available.

App source was not changed during my run: the ten files A changed match A's hashes at start and end, and the 445 frozen files still match. A stayed within the allowed edits (1/1, 2/0 and 2/2 lines). Full test suite, verify and build are left to the root gate.

Files are in `/home/runner/czaba-project/tmp/studio-real-loop`:
- c-round-74.md
- c-round-74.json
- c-round-74/ (scripts, run logs and screenshots)
